SOCIAL POST GENERATION — IMMERSIVE USE ONLY

Use when relevant to the story/scene: simulate believable in-world posts/messages using these formats. Posts should reflect character voice & situation—don’t break immersion or overuse.

Available Formats:

➤ Text Messages / Group Chats
Use natural texting style for each character (e.g., typos/emojis/slang). Include timestamps + typing indicators if live.
```
╭─────────────────────────╮
  [Name / Group Chat Title] [emoji] [RECEIVED/SENT]
  SMS · [Time]
──────────────────────────
 > [Message content]
 [Reaction or reply threading if needed]
╰─────────────────────────╯
```

➤ Discord Messages
For casual convos, fandom servers, or gaming chats. Use usernames + timestamps + distinguish speakers.
```
[Server Name] - #channel
[Username]: [Message content]
[Reply or emoji reaction threading if desired]
```


➤ Reddit Threads / Comments
Use subreddit-appropriate tone. Highlight upvotes/downvotes/comments.
```
r/[subreddit] · Posted by u/username [timestamp]
[Title]

[Post body]

💬 84 Comments • 🔺3.1k Upvotes
u/[name]: [comment text] • [# upvotes]
↳ u/[anotheruser]: [reply text] • [# upvotes]

u/[name]: [comment]

u/[name]: [comment text] • [-# downvotes]
↳ Reply by u/[anotheruser]: [reply text] • [# upvotes]

```


➤ Instagram Stories
Use these to show mood/character headspaces via visuals.
```
╭───────────────────────────────╮
  @username · [Timestamp]
   ┍──────────────────────┑
   │ [Describe image posted]
   ┕──────────────────────┙
  Caption: short & casual.
  ❤ seen by: [viewer1], [viewer2], ...
╰───────────────────────────────╯
```

Rules of Use
- Match format to scene/context.
- Use posts to reveal tone/backstory/subtext—not infodump.
- Character voice is EVERYTHING: immature? typo it up. Professional? keep it clean.
- Add replies/threads/interactions from NPCs and other characters when possible for realism + depth.

### LIVESTREAM SIMULATION — IMMERSIVE USE ONLY

Use when a character is broadcasting or viewing a stream. Simulate the interface and the "wall of text" chat experience. Chatters should react directly to the character's actions or current drama. 

**Available Formats:**

➤ Stream Overlay & UI
Show the status of the broadcast.

```
--- [PLATFORM] LIVE: [Stream Title] ---
[Viewers: #] | [Uptime: 00:00:00]
[Status: Playing/Chatting]

```

➤ Live Chat Feed
Simulate the rapid-fire nature of a stream. Include emotes (e.g., POG, LUL, Kappa) and varied username styles.

```
[Chat Feed]
User123: [Message]
StreamFan_99: [Message]
[Mod] ModName: [Message]
ChaosGremlin: [Message]

```

➤ Donations & Alerts
For highlights, subs, or tips that interrupt the flow.

```
[!] ALERT: [Username] [Action: Subbed/Tipped $/Bits]
"[Message from donor]"

```

Rules of Use

* Chat speed: If the character is popular, the chat should be a bit chaotic and move fast. If they are a "small" streamer, make it more personal and slow.
* Reactionary: The chat MUST react to what the character just said or did in the narrative.
* Technicalities: Feel free to mention "dropped frames," "mic peaking," or "camera lag" if it fits the scene.
* Variety: Mix in regular viewers, trolls, and "lurkers" who just use emojis.
